title: Test conversion mapping and Exercise validity
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover Strength and Stretch mapping and assert that source category information is retained.
Tests assert every converted list field is an array with the expected non-empty source values and every common-error pair has string error and correction values.
Tests assert converted ids are deterministic and unique and that compatibility instructions mirror structured steps.
Tests reject or fail conversion for missing required raw fields instead of creating partially valid Exercise records.
The conversion test file passes independently.
